summary: MaintStaff is part of a web application that handles staff management, including creation, editing, and deactivation of staff records.
purpose: The purpose of MaintStaff is to manage staff records within an organization. This includes allowing users to add, edit, deactivate, and manage roles and permissions for staff members.

workflows.name: Staff Management
steps: Search for staff using search criteria.
Select staff from the list for actions.
Add new staff by filling in details and saving.
Edit existing staff details and save changes.
Deactivate staff with reason and comments.
Move staff to a different department.

business_rules: System administrators have full access to all functionalities.
Local administrators can manage staff within their department.
Staff cannot be edited if they are not within the user's allowed departments.
Mandatory fields must be filled before saving a record.
validations: Email is validated against a regex pattern.
Phone and Fax numbers are validated using masked input.
Secure email must be different from the regular email.
calculations: DayMonthOfBirth is appended with year 1904 if only day and month are provided.
conditions: Only SystemAdministrators can edit staff when the staff is inactive.
Email fields are required if the department mandates email for staff.
system_behavior: Handles showing and hiding UI elements based on user roles and system settings.
Triggers AJAX updates for partial page refreshes.
exceptions: Duplicate staff names trigger display of a duplicate name panel.
Invalid email or phone entries trigger error panels.
content_gaps: Detailed roles and permissions for StaffAdmin are not fully described.
